newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tamil rebels kill 12 soldiers in eastern Sri Lankan.
newsitem.headline: Tamil rebels kill 12 soldiers in eastern Sri Lankan.

text.p: Tamil Tiger rebels ambushed an army patrol in eastern Batticaloa district on Monday killing 12 Sri Lankan soldiers, military officials said.
"An army route-clearing patrol was ambushed by a large group of terrorists," a military official in Batticaloa said. "We lost 12 soldiers."
A military spokesman confirmed the attack but said he was unable to give casualty figures immediately.
Military officials in Batticaloa, 220 km (138 miles) east of the capital Colombo, said reinforcements rushed to the scene of the attack near Valaichchenai were searching for the rebels.
Some attackers were believed to have taken cover among refugees in a nearby camp, they said.
Casualties among the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels, fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the island's north and east, were not known, they said.
Last week seven soldiers were killed by a suspected Tamil Tiger rebel landmine in the northern Jaffna peninsula.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE says the number is higher.
